subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the security and automation owners accept these exact 13 upstream executable revisions for workflows that handle tokens, secrets, publishing, and code-scanning data?
rationale: No line-level defect is evident, but accepting new third-party executable bundles at these credential and automation boundaries is an ownership decision that general CI cannot make.

options.title: Approve final pinned set
options.body: Accept the revisions after secops review and all required checks complete on the final rebased SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, CodeQL, or Docker publishing actions if owners need narrower provenance or rollback scope.

options.title: Hold current revisions
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place if any upstream bundle cannot be adequately reviewed or validated.

recommendation.title: Approve final pinned set
recommendation.body: Accept the revisions after secops review and all required checks complete on the final rebased SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: The team is the explicit CODEOWNER for multiple changed security workflows and is best positioned to accept executable revisions at this boundary.
